## Dire Shadow Rat (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 N Small undead  

**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +8  

  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)  

**hp** 11 (1d8+3)  

**Fort** +3, **Ref** +3, **Will** +3  

**Defensive Abilities** incorporeal form, shadow blend; **Immune** undead traits  

  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., climb 20 ft.  

**Melee** bite +4 (1d4+3 plus 1d3 Strength damage plus disease)  

**Special Attacks** disease (DC 13)  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 10, **Dex** 17, Con—, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 16  

**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 12 (16 vs. trip)  

**Feats** Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  

**Skills** Acrobatics +3 (+7 jump), Climb +8, Perception +8, Stealth +11; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth  

  

**Special Abilities**

 **Disease (Ex)** *Filth fever*: Bite–injury; *save* Fort DC 13, onset 1d3 days, frequency 1/day, effect 1d3 Dex damage and 1d3 Con damage, cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Charisma-based.  
 **Incorporeal Form (Su)** A shadow rat can, as a standard action, assume an incorporeal form for up to 1 hour per day. In this form, the shadow rat loses its natural AC bonus but gains a +2 deflection bonus to AC. While in this form, the shadow rat is AC 16 (+2 deflection, +2 Dex, +2 size), touch 15, flat-footed 13. The shadow rat can still attack corporeal opponents while in its incorporeal form, but its attack only inflicts Strength damage and cannot cause physical damage. The shadow rat gains the incorporeal subtype while using this ability.  
 **Shadow Blend (Ex)**  A shadow rat can disappear into the shadows as a move action, gaining total concealment in all levels of illumination save bright light.  
 **Strength Damage (Su)** A shadow rat deals Strength damage to living foes it bites. A creature reduced to 0 Strength cannot move but does not die–at least, not until the shadow rat’s physical damage takes its toll.
